$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema, or the page stops showing after a build.

tasks.name: workday-jobs-last-24-hours
tasks.title: Find every Workday job posted in the last 24 hours
tasks.description: Get the jobs that thousands of employers on Workday posted in the last day, newest first, with the company, location and link. Schedule it daily for a fresh job feed with no list of companies needed.
tasks.seoTitle: New Workday Jobs in the Last 24 Hours
tasks.seoDescription: Jobs posted on Workday career sites in the last day, across every employer, newest first, with company, location and link. Run it daily for a fresh feed.

tasks.name: remote-jobs-on-workday
tasks.title: Find remote jobs on Workday across every company
tasks.description: Get the newest remote jobs from every employer on Workday with one search, with the company, location, posting date and link. Remote is read from the job's title and location.
tasks.seoTitle: Remote Jobs on Workday, Every Company
tasks.seoDescription: Search every company on Workday for remote jobs at once, newest first, with company, location, posting date and link. No company list and no login needed.

tasks.name: software-engineer-jobs-workday
tasks.title: Find software engineer jobs on Workday at every company
tasks.description: Get the newest software engineer jobs from every employer on Workday with one keyword, with the company, location, posting date and link. No list of companies needed.
tasks.seoDescription: Search every company on Workday for software engineer jobs with one keyword, newest first, with company, location, posting date and job link.

tasks.name: data-analyst-jobs-workday
tasks.title: Find data analyst jobs on Workday at every company
tasks.description: Get the newest data analyst jobs from every employer on Workday with one keyword, with the company, location, posting date and link. Add a country to narrow it.
tasks.seoDescription: Search every company on Workday for data analyst jobs with one keyword, newest first, with company, location, posting date and job link. No login needed.

tasks.name: registered-nurse-jobs-usa-workday
tasks.title: Find registered nurse jobs in the United States on Workday
tasks.description: Get the newest registered nurse jobs in the United States from the hospitals and health systems on Workday, with the employer, city, posting date and link.
tasks.seoTitle: Registered Nurse Jobs in the USA on Workday
tasks.seoDescription: Search the hospitals and health systems on Workday for registered nurse jobs in the United States, newest first, with employer, city, date and link.

tasks.name: internships-on-workday-last-7-days
tasks.title: Find internships posted on Workday in the last 7 days
tasks.description: Get the internships that employers on Workday posted in the last week, newest first, with the company, location and link. Schedule it weekly during recruiting season.
tasks.seoDescription: Internships posted on Workday career sites in the last 7 days, across every employer, newest first, with company, location, posting date and job link.

tasks.name: manager-jobs-germany-workday
tasks.title: Find manager jobs in Germany on Workday
tasks.description: Get the newest manager jobs in Germany from every employer on Workday, including jobs posted for several countries, with the company, city, posting date and link.
tasks.seoTitle: Manager Jobs in Germany on Workday
tasks.seoDescription: Search every company on Workday for manager jobs in Germany, including jobs posted for several countries, newest first, with company, city, date and link.

tasks.name: check-workday-job-links
tasks.title: Check whether Workday job links are still open
tasks.description: Paste Workday job links and each comes back open or closed, with the job's details when it is open. Handy for cleaning dead links out of a job board or a spreadsheet.
tasks.seoTitle: Check if Workday Job Links Are Still Open
tasks.seoDescription: Paste Workday job links and see which are still open and which are closed. Clean dead links out of a job board or a spreadsheet, with no login or API key.
